project_name: Personal Almanac V1 - Multi-Calendar & Astronomical Cycles Dashboard
theme: Light mode baseline (#F8FAFC) with deep slate navy high-contrast hierarchy (#0F172A), crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0), and vivid thematic multi-spectrum micro-accents for astrological layers.
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss editorial grid precision combined with ancient Indonesian cosmological multi-calendar mathematics and live astronomical telemetry.
Emotion First: The feeling of standing beneath the Bandung night sky while reading centuries of Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese, and Lunar wisdom synchronized to the second.
Observational Precision: Every card is a high-density, high-clarity instrument. 0% fluff, 100% intentional typography, exact data metrics, and micro-interactive feedback.
Negative Space & Rhythm: 8px grid pacing, clean 1px border frames, generous internal card padding, zero edge collisions.
Tactile Micro-Interactions: Smooth spring hover elevations, live ticking astronomical status pulses, interactive date/time scrubbers, and live calculation recalibration.

layout_architecture.container_max_width: max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6

top_header.description: Sticky/pinned navigation bar with glass backdrop blur (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 z-40). Contains Brand Logo badge, Page Title 'Explore' with historical/live badge, Date + Coordinates location readout, Live WIB Clock with active pulse, and Location Switcher dropdown (Bandung, Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Bali, Surabaya, Medan).

main_grid.pattern: 12-column responsive layout with 2-column split (Left: 8 cols / 2fr for astronomical & calendar telemetry; Right: 4 cols / 1fr for interactive calendar picker & schedule timeline)

month_calendar_panel.title: DATE EXPLORER & TIME SCRUBBER
features: Interactive Month Grid with previous/next month navigation
Selected date pill highlight (#0F172A dark navy fill with white text)
Hover micro-states for day numbers showing weton preview tooltip
Time Scrubber slider allowing the user to fast-forward time to simulate sun altitude and shadow cast changes
Quick jump presets: 'Today (Live)', 'Next Full Moon', 'Next Solstice/Equinox', 'Upcoming Eclipse'

footer_status_bar.description: Minimalist high-precision telemetry footer with 1px border-top (#E2E8F0).
items: Data Source: Bandung Lembang Astronomical Data Mesh (Bosscha Reference Station)
Engine: Personal Almanac Ephemeris Engine v1.8.4
Status: Operational (100% Synced to UTC+7 WIB)
Calculations: Real astronomical algorithms for any selected coordinates and dates

interactive_states.date_picker: Full calendar month navigation with month jump dropdown, day clicking with instant live recalculation of all natural cycles and Indonesian calendars.
interactive_states.time_slider: Live hour and minute scrubber that updates the Sun altitude graphic, solar progress ring, and schedule focus dynamically.
interactive_states.weton_detail_modal: Clicking on any calendar system card opens an interactive drawer or modal unpacking the complete mathematical breakdown (Neptu, Pasaran, Dino 7, Dino 5, Wuku, Padangon, Pangarasan, and Rakam).

visual_enhancers.sun_arc_svg: Interactive curved SVG path with a glowing sun icon that tracks the selected time across dawn, sunrise, solar noon, sunset, and dusk.
visual_enhancers.moon_phase_canvas: Accurate 2D vector graphic showing the illuminated crescent/gibbous terminator according to moon age (0-29.53 days).
visual_enhancers.annual_cycle_progress_bar: Segmented seasonal ring/bar showing current day in the 365-day Gregorian year, Javanese Pranata Mangsa seasons, and Solstice/Equinox markers.
visual_enhancers.pulse_status_indicators: Subtle green/amber radar ping dots indicating active live telemetry.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_nav: Frosted glass header (`bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/80`) to ensure readability over scrolling content.
visual_enhancers.elevation_hover: Subtle hover lift (`transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease`) with 1px border highlight (`hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-md`).

bandung_landscape.description: Bandung lush highlands and mountain sunrise landscape for the Solar & Geographic reference backdrop

bandung_city_twilight.description: Twilight view of Bandung basin under dramatic sky for evening dusk and sunset telemetry visualizer

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact light-themed baseline (#F8FAFC, #FFFFFF cards, #E2E8F0 1px borders, #0F172A primary dark navy text/pills) requested by the user.

Implement real astronomical calculations in /app/frontend/src/lib/almanacCalculations.js for exact sunrise/sunset, solar noon, moon phase illumination percentage, moon age, Javanese Pasaran (Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon), Javanese Dino 7, Neptu sums, Saka Sunda date, and Balinese Pawukon/Wuku for any selected date and Indonesian coordinates.
Keep the dashboard strictly on the main dashboard layout per user choice ('Main dashboard only, no spec side panels').

Support full interactivity: changing the location updates sunrise/sunset and coordinates; scrubbing the time updates the solar position visualizer; picking a calendar date recalculates all natural layers and multi-calendar cards in real time.
Include rich micro-interactions using framer-motion (staggered card reveal, active pill spring transitions, subtle hover elevations).
Ensure every interactive element has the required data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use dark mode as full page background; keep the light background #F8FAFC with crisp contrast #0F172A.
Do NOT center align the whole app; keep structured left-aligned editorial hierarchy.
Ensure 1px solid border (#E2E8F0) on cards with generous internal padding (p-5 or p-6).
Use Framer Motion with specific property transitions (opacity, transform) and avoid universal 'transition: all'.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for any user alerts or location change toast notifications.
